notes: All six required web searches ran this time, plus two extra (eight in total); none returned any statement by Dina Titus about AI risk, superintelligence, extinction, a pause, China talks or AI safety. The site-restricted search returned no titus.house.gov pages, so the earlier direct reading of titus.house.gov is kept: the home page and press release list pages 1 to 3 (releases from 30 April to 5 November 2026), and the data center releases of 9 July, 23 July, 17 August, 1 September and 16 September 2026; none of her quoted words mention AI. The 16 September 2026 release (https://titus.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=5933), on her bill for transparency and environmental review of data centers on federal land, mentions AI only in its own narration (the Trump administration pushing rapid expansion of AI data centers), not in her words; at most this would be level D, and verbatim text was not extracted. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538): the FastDemocracy cosponsor page (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/) lists 12 cosponsors and she is not among them; Congress.gov was not checked (it returned 403 earlier), so a later cosponsorship cannot be fully ruled out. A 16 April 2026 article on a House AI roundtable about existential fears (reposted on min.house.gov) does not mention her. No House letter about AI risk led or signed by her was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). Press releases before 30 April 2026 and all of 2025 on her own site were not read page by page, but the searches covered that period.
